description: The file contains the implementation of CodeMirror, a web-based code editor, including core functions, event handling, mode resolution, string stream processing, line highlighting, and span management.

classes.name: Line
classes.description: Represents a line of text with associated state, styles, and marked spans.

classes.name: LineView
classes.description: Represents the visual and logical view of lines, including handling collapsed spans, widgets, and styling.

classes.name: Pos
classes.description: Represents a position within the document, characterized by line and character offset.
